title: Primes in arithmetic progressions to large moduli and refinements of Harman's sieve
summary: We study the average distribution of primes of size $x$ in arithmetic progressions to moduli larger than $x^{\frac{1}{2}}$. Using arithmetic information from the works of many authors together with different variants of the original Harman's sieve, we construct suitable majorants and minorants for the prime indicator function $\mathbb{1}_{p}(n)$ that satisfy Bombieri--Vinogradov type mean value theorems with different types of moduli.
